githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.6 Beta 4 adds server reordering, folder customization, invite creation, threads from the composer, and attachment pasting. It also redesigns polls and improves spoilers, presence updates, video previews, and Inbox reliability.

## Servers and invites

- Added drag-and-drop server reordering and moving servers into and out of folders, synchronized with Discord.
- Added folder name and color customization, plus Mark Folder as Read.
- Added invite creation from the server menu with expiration, use limits, and temporary membership settings.
- Added a saved list of invite links created in SakuraCord so they can be copied again later.

## Threads and attachments

- Added Create Thread to the composer, with public and private threads where permitted and support for text and attachments in the first message.
- Improved thread cards and removed stale previews when threads or their messages change or are deleted.
- Added pasting images and files into messages, forum posts, and slash-command attachment fields.
- Added automatic conversion of pasted text longer than 4,000 characters into a `message.txt` attachment.
- Added first-frame previews for video attachments and fixed media reply previews when loading older messages.

## Polls

- Redesigned poll creation with expandable answer rows, emoji choices, and keyboard navigation.
- Improved voting feedback with animated results and voter lists organized by answer.
- Fixed selected answers and vote counts becoming stale during refreshes, including in Inbox, search, and Server Guide resources.
- Added retry controls for failed voter-list loads and refreshed voter lists when vote counts change.

## Spoilers and message display

- Fixed revealed text spoilers becoming hidden again during message redraws.
- Improved spoiler concealment across formatted text, links, emoji, forum previews, reply previews, and notifications.
- Prevented hidden invite links from exposing invite previews.
- Fixed profiles and role mentions opened from messages using the wrong server context.

## Profiles and presence

- Added phone-shaped presence indicators for members connected through mobile, including Idle and Do Not Disturb colors.
- Fixed open profiles failing to update with live presence changes and the DM profile sidebar failing to reload after dismissal.
- Improved synchronization of your status with Discord, including reconnects and overlapping settings changes.
- Fixed default member avatars, fallback initials, and server initials.

## Inbox and app behavior

- Fixed Inbox messages losing newer updates during loading, undo, or failed mark-as-read actions.
- Fixed bulk mark-as-read actions clearing notifications for newer unread messages.
- Prevented channels hidden behind Server Guide and other server pages from being automatically marked as read.
- Added thread viewing within Server Guide resources and retry support for failed resource history loads.
- Kept SakuraCord and active calls running when the last window closes.
- Added Report a Bug, Suggest a Feature, and SakuraCord Tracker to the Help menu.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.6-Beta-3...v0.1.6-Beta-4](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.6-Beta-3...v0.1.6-Beta-4)
discordAnnouncement:
**Server reordering, folder customization, and invite creation 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Drag servers into your preferred order, move them between folders, and customize folder names and colors, with changes synced to Discord.
- Create invite links with expiration and use limits, then copy links you previously created in SakuraCord.
- Start public or private threads from the composer where permitted, and paste images and files into messages, forum posts, and slash-command attachment fields.
- Redesigned poll creation and voter lists, with more reliable vote counts and selected answers.
- Video attachments now show first-frame previews, and revealed text spoilers stay visible.
- Mobile presence indicators, live profile status updates, and calls that continue when you close the window.
